connector.name: Clearlist
connector.registryDescription: AI resale manager. Photograph an item, AI writes the listing, publish a sale page, manage pickups.
connector.summary: Hosted at clearlist.me over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cuneiform-llc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLEARLIST_API_KEY
env.description: ClearList API key (cl_<64-hex>). Optional — if omitted, an agent can acquire one at runtime via the email-verification onboarding tools.

env.name: CLEARLIST_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the ClearList API. Defaults to https://clearlist.me.
